list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Yb(III) and selenido ions alternate at the vertices of a Yb4Se4 cube. Each octahedral Yb(III) center also binds one terminal SePh and two pyridine ligands.

synthesis.procedure: (py)4Yb(SePh)2 reacts with elemental selenium in pyridine to form the cluster. The main text gives no numerical reagent quantity.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as deep red crystals; further details are not given in the main text.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A Yb4S4 cubane fragment has an additional Yb2S2 layer capping one cube face. The six Yb(III) centers occupy three distinct octahedral coordination environments involving bridging sulfide, pyridine, and terminal SPh ligands.

synthesis.procedure: PhSSPh is reduced with a Yb/Hg amalgam in pyridine to form Yb(SPh)3; elemental sulfur is then added. The solution is filtered and saturated to obtain crystals. The main text gives no numerical reagent quantity.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Saturation of the filtered solution affords red crystals.
